image_alt: Vila puzzle feeder dog toy with sliding treat compartments
what_didnt_work: It's just too easy for him. He cleared it almost as fast as eating out of a regular bowl, so as a mental enrichment tool for a dog who's already puzzle-savvy, it doesn't really slow him down or make him think much.
what_we_tested: We loaded the sliding compartments with treats and kibble and watched how Remy worked through it, same as we'd judge any puzzle toy: does he engage right away, how long does it hold his attention, and does it actually slow him down.
what_worked: Remy went straight for it with zero coaxing. The adjustable sliding compartments are a nice touch if you've got a dog who's newer to puzzle toys and needs an easier starting point. No durability issues so far, the compartments still slide smoothly.
worth_buying: Yes, if your dog is newer to puzzle toys or you want something simple for slow feeding. If your dog already solves puzzles quickly like Remy does, treat this as an easy win rather than a real challenge. The price is low enough that it's a fine pickup either way.
verdict_title: Remy approved, but it won't challenge him long
remys_take: He wasn't bothered by the lack of challenge, he just wanted the treats and got them. Didn't really register as a "puzzle" to him.
verdict_text: A simple, adjustable puzzle feeder that's genuinely good for a dog new to puzzle toys. Remy is not new to puzzle toys, so he breezed through it without slowing down much. Still useful, just not a real mental workout for him specifically.
card_summary: A sliding-compartment puzzle feeder. Remy cleared it instantly, no help needed. Good entry-level puzzle, not much of a challenge for him.
title: Vila Puzzle Feeder: Remy's Test Notes
lede: This is a sliding-compartment puzzle feeder that's supposed to make Remy work for his treats. He got it immediately, no help, no hesitation. Good for slowing down a fast eater, just don't expect it to hold a smart dog's attention for long.
product_name: Vila Puzzle Feeder Interactive Mental Enrichment & Training Treat Dispensing Dog Toy
description: Remy tested the Vila Puzzle Feeder treat-dispensing toy. He solved it immediately with no coaxing, which makes it a great starter puzzle but not much of a challenge for an experienced dog.

faqs.question: Is the Vila Puzzle Feeder good for experienced puzzle dogs?
faqs.answer: Not really. Remy solved it immediately with no challenge. It's better suited for dogs newer to puzzle toys.

faqs.question: Does it actually slow down eating?
faqs.answer: Somewhat, but for a dog already used to puzzle toys, it won't slow them down much.

faqs.question: Is it durable?
faqs.answer: No issues so far in our testing, but we'll update if anything changes with continued use.
